sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Chandipur Beach
sources.note: Odisha Tourism, Chandipur Beach, How to Reach: Baleshwar rail arrival and road access. Checked 20 October 2026; no hotel or transfer availability verified.

locators.detail-0: How to Reach & Map: Rail identifies Baleshwar as the nearest railway station; Road describes access from Baleshwar.

sources.inspection: Actual current page freshly inspected on 20 October 2026; existing source identity reused.
limits: Source gives arrival geography, not station-to-property distances, travel times, transport reliability, prices or hotel endorsements.
No generic 24-hour opening, free-entry, deep-seabed-walking or seasonal assurance imported.

sources.title: Saha and colleagues · Chandipur sedimentation study (2023)
sources.note: Saha and colleagues (2023), pp. 6–7, Study Area: gently sloping tidal flat beside a narrower beach. Terrain explanation, not a tide forecast or property assessment.

locators.detail-2: Printed pp. 6–7, Study Area: broad, gently dipping tidal flat and narrower landward beach. The relation between slope and waterline is a plain geometric inference, reused from the Chandipur article.

sources.inspection: Actual PDF text, Study Area section, freshly inspected on 20 October 2026; existing source reused after reviewing the KB, Chandipur and Balasore records.
limits: No current tide, safe access, bathing conditions, property view or room-to-water distance verified.
The paper’s storm maximum and older tidal range are not used as current limits.
